summary: This unit covers various drivers of land degradation including deforestation, forest degradation, non-timber forest use, fire regimes, invasive species, land abandonment, mining, and urbanization, and discusses the challenges in monitoring these processes.

heading_path: 4. STATUS AND TRENDS OF LAND DEGRADATION AND RESTORATION AND ASSOCIATED CHANGES IN BIODIVERSITY AND ECOSYSTEM FUNCTIONS
passages.text: Reduced evapotranspiration, infiltration rates and water-holding capacities can cause increased runoff and a decrease in watershed protection, leading to an increase in flooding, erosion and reduced water supply for human use.

heading_path: 4. STATUS AND TRENDS OF LAND DEGRADATION AND RESTORATION AND ASSOCIATED CHANGES IN BIODIVERSITY AND ECOSYSTEM FUNCTIONS
passages.text: Trees are planted on farms for many reasons: often for supplementary income, but also for conservation-related purposes such as wind breaks, runoff reduction and sediment trapping to minimize erosion. Trees can also capture nutrients that might otherwise be lost to leaching and so reduce nitrogen loading in streams. Agroforestry practices can sequester carbon and enhance microbial biomass and enhance water-holding capacity compared to monoculture.

heading_path: 4. STATUS AND TRENDS OF LAND DEGRADATION AND RESTORATION AND ASSOCIATED CHANGES IN BIODIVERSITY AND ECOSYSTEM FUNCTIONS
4.3.5 Non-timber forest use: woodfuel, bushmeat, edible plants, and medicinal herbs
passages.text: Fuelwood harvesting, can result in overall structural changes of the vegetation, converting a forest or woodland area into shrubland or grassland, with impacts on productivity, soil erosion and biodiversity. It can have secondary impacts on fire regimes which may restrict woody plant re-generation.

heading_path: 4. STATUS AND TRENDS OF LAND DEGRADATION AND RESTORATION AND ASSOCIATED CHANGES IN BIODIVERSITY AND ECOSYSTEM FUNCTIONS
passages.text: In the miombo regions of Africa, thinning of trees leads to increases in grass density, and hence more intense fires. This can then further damage the remaining late succession and fire intolerant trees, resulting in a grassland or open woodland, dominated by early succession, fire tolerant trees.

passages.text: Higher ecosystem diversity is associated with resistance to invasive species, but not always.

passages.text: In the urban region in the Yangtze River Delta, net primary production decreased significantly due to urbanization processes from 1999 to 2010. Lu et al. (2010) and Wu et al. (2014) showed with a probability greater than 75% that infrastructure has a strong linear relationship with net primary production over the South-eastern China.
